title: 第5章 筑基丹

第一卷 败落的岳家第五章筑基丹 求收藏推荐

“欣儿，你怎么知道我在这，我想去店铺看看。”看着眼前的苏欣儿，岳诚不由暗道，这小妮子再过几年肯定是一个祸国殃民的主。

“我去你房间找你，看见你不在，佣人们说你在这，所以我就来找你了，你以前从来都不去店铺的，怎么今天突然想去了。”苏欣儿疑惑的看着岳诚，以前表哥是出来不管店铺的事情的。

“我去找点东西。”岳诚回道，在记忆中他也知道以前是从不管店铺的事情的。

“那我陪你去吧，我看你连店铺在哪你都不知道吧。”苏欣儿对岳诚微微一笑，表哥好像从没有去过岳家店铺。

“这，那好吧。”岳诚一楞，自己好像还真不知道岳家的店铺都在什么地方，也只好让苏欣儿跟着了。

两人出了岳家大宅在苏欣儿的带领下，穿过了几条小街来到了立英镇上一条热闹的大街上，路上岳诚也告诉了苏欣儿自己想去买卖兵器和药物的店铺去看看。

“岳家兵铺”是岳家专门从事兵器和药物买卖的店铺，只是生意已经越来越差了，镇上不少的人都喜欢在对面一家叫做“黄家兵铺”的地方去买东西。

岳家兵铺里面主要经营着一些低等的兵器和修练者不可或缺的丹药，当然这些丹药也是上不了什么大台面的，这些丹药都是岳家高价请来的一个二品炼药师练出来的，一个二品的炼药师在这个小镇已经是风光无限和了不起的大人物，地位就是一个大斗师和三级魔法师都没法比的。

炼药师的低级分别是从一品到九品，成为炼药师的条件太苛刻，而且晋级也是困难的很，加上不管是魔法师还是斗师都离不开丹药，所以也就造成了炼药师的崇高地位。

两人来到岳家兵铺的时候，店铺内的人也认出了岳诚和苏欣儿，连忙跟两人打了招呼。

岳诚微微的打量着岳家兵铺，面积规模不算小，里面的东西也是挺多的，一共有着五六个人在里面忙碌着。

“峰叔。”一个身穿青色长袍的中年人出现在了岳诚的身边，岳诚微微一礼叫道。这人是岳诚的叔叔岳子峰，这间店铺就是由他负责的，这间兵铺也是岳家现在最多的一个店铺。

“诚儿，今天怎么有空到峰叔这来了，平时峰叔怎么拉你都不来，出来转转也好，至少心情会好一点，以后就跟着峰叔做生意好了。”岳子峰对岳诚微微笑道，看得出来，他对岳诚也是很喜欢的。

“峰叔，我也跟着你学做生意好不好。”苏欣儿明亮的眼睛狡洁的看着岳子峰说道。

“你啊，你个小丫头真是越来越漂亮了，再过一两年等你娇姐姐回来就让你们都找个婆家嫁了。”岳子峰每次看着苏欣儿都会想起自己的女儿，娇儿也就是比她大上几个月。

“峰叔坏死了，每次都拿我开玩笑，不理你了。”苏欣儿的娇脸上迅速起了一丝绯红，每次见到峰叔都会被他打趣，连忙跑到里面去玩了，免得再被他打趣。

看着苏欣儿的模样，岳子峰也是微微一笑，这丫头是越来越漂亮了，也不知道娇儿现在怎么样。

“峰叔，我想看看兵器和药材可以吗？”岳诚对岳子峰微微问道，这里是岳子峰在负责，自然要经过他同意。

“可以，都在里面，你自己去看吧。”岳子峰疑惑的打量着岳诚，他没有修练斗气也没有修练魔法，不知他要看这些做什么，虽然疑惑，但也让岳诚进去里面了。

“多谢峰叔。”岳诚对岳子峰微微道谢，随后便走进了店铺里面，在外面的时候岳诚就一直在看里面的东西了。

“精铁打造，玄铁打造。”岳诚拿着架子上的兵器一一的仔细看了一遍，脸上露出了一丝兴奋的微笑，这些兵器的材料和华夏的差不多，都可以炼制成法器。

“血灵草，五叶果。”随即，岳诚来到了另外一边的架子上，上面有着一些丹药。岳诚拿起了一颗仔细打量，心中再次大喜，原来所谓的丹药和自己以前炼制的丹药差不多，所用的药材也是一样，只是叫法不一样而已。

“诚儿，你还懂丹药啊？”岳子峰看着岳诚脸色兴奋的表情，走到岳诚的身边问道。

“懂一些，峰叔，你这有没有零散的药材，我要找一些，有用。”岳诚微微对岳子峰问道，既然是一样的，那自己也应该尽快炼制出筑基丹才行。服下筑基丹后自己的修为才能稳定，对以后的修为也有想不到的好处。好在筑基丹也不是什么高级的丹药，以现在自己筑基初期的修为加上自身的境界应该有机会炼制成功的。

“里面就有，跟我来吧。”看着岳诚的表情，岳子峰疑惑不已，随即把岳诚带到了里面一个密室里面。

跟着岳子峰来到了密室，这是一间由青石构筑的房间，面积不大，里面存放着不少的药材。岳诚老远就闻到了一股浓郁的药味，密室的中央架子上摆满了很多还没有炼制成丹药的药材。

看着密室内的药材，岳诚微微的皱了皱眉，这些药材的层次实在是入不了他的眼。这也难怪，想他以前的超级修为，所用的药材全都是难得一见的天地奇宝，就这些普通的药材自然没法比。

岳诚站在药架前仔细的寻找了起来，好在炼制筑基丹也不需要什么天材地宝，一些普通的药材就可以了，不过其中炼制筑基丹最重要的一味药材‘精气芝’也有些珍贵。

“峰叔，你这有没有精气芝？”岳诚在药架前找了一遍，炼制筑基丹的药材其它都找到了，唯独没有找到最重要的精气芝，要是少了这味药材，筑基丹可就炼不成了。

“你要精气芝做什么，岳家现在一共也才几颗精气芝。”岳子峰疑惑的问道，看着岳诚的模样，好像是要炼制什么丹药，好像从没有听说过他会炼制丹药，要是这小子真会炼制丹药是一名炼药师的话，岳家也就不会这样了。

Volume 1: The Decline of the Yue Family, Chapter 5: Foundation Building Pill. Please recommend for collection.

"Xin'er, how did you know I'm here? I want to go to the store." Looking at Su Xin'er in front of him, Yue Cheng couldn't help but secretly thought that in a few years this little girl would definitely bring disaster to the country and the people.

"I went to your room to look for you and saw that you weren't there. The servants said you were here, so I came to find you. You never went to the store before, why did you suddenly want to go today." Su Xin'er looked at Yue Cheng in confusion. In the past, her cousin was out to care about the store.

"I'm looking for something." Yue Cheng replied. In his memory, he also knew that he never paid attention to the store's affairs before.

"Then let me go with you. I think you don't even know where the store is." Su Xin'er smiled slightly at Yue Cheng. It seemed that her cousin had never been to Yue's store.

"Well, okay then." Yue Cheng was stunned. He didn't seem to know where the Yue family's shops were, so he had no choice but to let Su Xin'er follow.

The two of them left the Yue family mansion and were led by Su Xin'er, and walked through several small streets to a lively street in Liying Town. On the way, Yue Cheng also told Su Xin'er that he wanted to visit a store that sells weapons and medicines.

"Yue Family Arms Store" is a store specialized in the sale of weapons and medicines of the Yue Family, but the business has been getting worse and worse. Many people in the town like to buy things at a place called "Huang Family Arms Store" opposite.

The Yue family's weapons shop mainly sells some low-level weapons and elixirs that are indispensable for practitioners. Of course, these elixirs are not on the big stage. These elixirs are all made by a second-level alchemist hired by the Yue family at a high price. A second-level alchemist is already a famous and great figure in this small town. His status is incomparable to that of a great fighter or a third-level magician.

The lower levels of alchemists range from the first to the ninth level. The conditions for becoming an alchemist are too harsh, and it is also very difficult to advance. In addition, both magicians and fighting masters cannot do without elixirs, so this has resulted in the lofty status of alchemists.

When the two came to the Yue Family Arms Shop, people in the shop also recognized Yue Cheng and Su Xin'er and quickly greeted them.

Yue Cheng looked at the Yue Family Arms Shop slightly. The area was not small, and there were quite a lot of things inside. There were a total of five or six people busy inside.

"Uncle Feng." A middle-aged man wearing a blue robe appeared next to Yue Cheng, and Yue Cheng called with a slight bow.This person is Yue Cheng's uncle Yue Zifeng, and he is in charge of this store. This military store is also the largest store in the Yue family.

"Cheng'er, why are you here today when you are free? Uncle Feng usually doesn't come here no matter what, so why not come out for a walk? At least you will be in a better mood. From now on, you can do business with Uncle Feng." Yue Zifeng smiled slightly at Yue Cheng. It was obvious that he also liked Yue Cheng.

"Uncle Feng, how about I also learn business from you?" Su Xin'er looked at Yue Zifeng with her bright eyes and said slyly.

"You, you little girl are getting more and more beautiful. In a year or two, when your charming sister comes back, I will let you all find a husband to marry." Every time Yue Zifeng looks at Su Xin'er, he will think of his own daughter. Jiao'er is just a few months older than her.

"Uncle Feng is so bad. He makes fun of me every time and ignores you." A blush quickly appeared on Su Xin'er's face. Every time she saw Uncle Feng, she would be teased by him. She quickly ran inside to play to avoid being teased by him again.

Looking at Su Xin'er's appearance, Yue Zifeng also smiled slightly. This girl is getting more and more beautiful. He doesn't know how Jiao'er is doing now.

"Uncle Feng, can I see the weapons and medicinal materials?" Yue Cheng asked Yue Zifeng slightly. Yue Zifeng was in charge here, so his consent was naturally required.

"Okay, it's all inside. You can go and see for yourself." Yue Zifeng looked at Yue Cheng doubtfully. He didn't practice fighting spirit or magic. He didn't know what he wanted to see. Although he was confused, he let Yue Cheng inside.

"Thank you, Uncle Feng." Yue Cheng thanked Yue Zifeng slightly, and then walked into the shop. While outside, Yue Cheng had been looking at the things inside.

"Made from fine iron, made from black iron." Yue Cheng took the weapons on the shelf and looked at them carefully one by one, with an excited smile on his face. The materials of these weapons are similar to those of China, and they can all be refined into magic weapons.

"Blood spirit grass, five-leaf fruit." Immediately, Yue Cheng came to the shelf on the other side, with some pills on it.Yue Cheng picked up one and looked at it carefully, and was overjoyed again. It turned out that the so-called elixir was similar to the elixir he had refined before, and the medicinal materials used were the same, but the name was different.

"Cheng'er, do you still know about elixirs?" Yue Zifeng looked at the excited expression on Yue Cheng's face and walked to Yue Cheng's side and asked.

"Know more, Uncle Feng, do you have any scattered medicinal materials here? I want to find some, useful." Yue Cheng asked Yue Zifeng slightly. Since they are the same, he should refine the Foundation Building Pill as soon as possible.Only after taking the Foundation Building Pill can one's own cultivation be stable, and it will also have unexpected benefits for future cultivation.Fortunately, the Foundation Establishment Pill is not a high-level elixir. With my current cultivation level in the early stage of Foundation Establishment and my own realm, I should have a chance to successfully refine it.

"It's inside, come with me." Looking at Yue Cheng's expression, Yue Zifeng was puzzled, and then took Yue Cheng into a secret room inside.

He followed Yue Zifeng to the secret room, which was a small room made of bluestone and contained a lot of medicinal materials.Yue Cheng smelled a strong smell of medicine from afar. The central shelf of the secret room was filled with many medicinal materials that had not yet been refined into elixirs.

Looking at the medicinal materials in the secret room, Yue Cheng frowned slightly. The level of these medicinal materials was really unacceptable to him.It's no wonder, considering his previous super cultivation, the medicinal materials used were all rare treasures from the world, and these ordinary medicinal materials were naturally incomparable.

Yue Cheng stood in front of the medicine shelf and searched carefully. Fortunately, refining the Foundation Establishment Pill did not require any heavenly materials or earthly treasures. Some ordinary medicinal materials were enough. However, the most important medicinal material for refining the Foundation Establishment Pill, 'Jingqi Zhi', was also somewhat precious.

"Uncle Feng, do you have Jing Qi Zhi?" Yue Cheng searched in front of the medicine shelf and found all the other medicinal materials for refining the Foundation Establishment Pill, except for the most important Jing Qi Zhi. Without this medicinal material, the Foundation Establishment Pill would not be refined.

"What do you want Jingqi Zhi for? There are only a few Jingqi Zhi in the Yue family now." Yue Zifeng asked doubtfully. Looking at Yue Cheng, he seemed to be refining some elixir. It seemed that he had never heard of him refining elixirs. If this kid really knew how to refine elixirs and was an alchemist, the Yue family would not be like this.
